target_customer: Commercial and local service businesses such as janitorial, HVAC, landscaping, roofing and pest control that sell to local business and property owners
problem: Blue-collar service companies find leads and follow up by hand; Cohesive automates prospect research, outreach and follow-up in a CRM.
business_model: B2B SaaS growth engine and CRM, pricing not stated (demo only)
product_category: AI sales and CRM for local service businesses

founders.name: Kevin Zhang
previous_startups: A service business with over 50K MRR, co-founded with Nam Nguyen

founders.name: Nam Nguyen
education: Williams College, BA Computer Science and Math
previous_startups: A service business with over 50K MRR, co-founded with Kevin Zhang

technical_complexity.rationale: Contact list building, multichannel outreach automation and signal monitoring on top of LLMs and data providers is mostly integration work for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Outbound automation is easy to copy; a vertical focus and CRM data create modest switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Field service platforms added AI receptionists and follow-up tools by 2025 to 2026 but no acquisition of Cohesive found.

market_need_then: Founders ran a service business to over 50K MRR themselves and saw sales prospecting as the bottleneck; YC launch post claims 350+ customers by launch.

branding.domain_note: Uses getcohesiveai.com, not an exact cohesive.com or similar; no acquisition story found.

identity.logo: Text wordmark only; no description of a mark found
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, short punchy lines aimed at Main Street businesses

brand_strength.rationale: Generic dictionary word shared with several unrelated Cohesive companies (Unacademy's Cohesive AI, Cohesive Solutions); no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Cohesive is active and, per late 2026 reports, acquired Maverick AI, a roofing sales platform, in November 2026 while claiming 1,000+ service business customers on its site. Funding is not confirmed by a primary source. Founder experience running a service business matches the customer, but the category is crowded and the name is generic.
notes: Funding unverified: PitchBook snippet says 7.11M with a seed on 2025-01-24 and another about 4.62M on 2026-05-02, VCBacked says 4.5M with a seed in December 2025, Prospeo lists two July 2025 rounds with no amounts; these conflict and no primary announcement was found so no rounds recorded. The company site names backers Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, Liquid 2 and Unshackled but no amounts. Website claims 1,000+ businesses while the YC launch post claimed 350+. Competitor search returned only 2026 vendor comparison pages, nothing dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Maverick AI acquisition is from a single outlet.
